ex.s: People in Ethiopian highlands have adapted to living at high altitudes.
ex.t: 埃塞俄比亚高原的人们已经适应了在高海拔生活。

ex.s: One day, I attended a presentation by wildlife conservationist Grant Brown at my high school.
ex.t: 一天，我在高中参加了野生动物保护主义者格兰特·布朗的讲座。

ex.s: When I studied chemistry high school, I reconsidered mg goal or decided to be a doctor.
ex.t: 当我在高中学生物化学时，我重新考虑了自己的目标，决定当医生。

ex.t: 你的班主任 1 你高中第一天感觉如何？

ex.s: It is believed that today's children and teenagers are consuming three times the recommended level of sugar, putting them at a higher risk of the disease.
ex.t: 据信，如今的儿童和青少年摄入的糖是建议量的三倍，使他们患该病的风险更高。

defs.def: at or to a large cost, value or amount （成本、价值）高；（数量）大

ex.s: In the Sierra high country, the number of big trees has fallen by more than 55 percent; in parts of southern California the decline was nearly 75 percent.
ex.t: 在内华达高海拔地区，大树的数量下降了超过55%；在南加州部分地区，下降幅度接近75%。

ex.s: Rankings, however, are only one reason why a low value is placed on teaching in higher education.
ex.t: 然而，排名只是高等教育中教学价值被低估的一个原因。

ex.s: However, obtaining items that are rare, recently published or in high demand may take longer.
ex.t: 然而，获取稀有、新出版或需求量大的物品可能需要更长时间。

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 在小学、初中和高中阶段，我的大部分阅读都是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，为了在考试中拿A。偶尔，我也会读老师指定的小说，但我并不喜欢这种阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的东西。我认为任何抽象的事物都留下了太多争论的空间。

ex.s: When Sonja Detrinidad opened her online shop selling houseplants, she didn’t have high hopes for it.
ex.t: 当索妮娅·德特里尼达开设了她的在线室内植物店时，她对此并没有抱太大期望。

ex.s: In Australia we now have over twenty million cars for just over twenty-six million people, among the highest rate of car ownership in the world.
ex.t: 在澳大利亚，我们现在有超过两千万辆汽车，对应着仅超过两千六百万的人口，汽车拥有率位居世界前列。

ex.s: In the north of India, the population is booming due to high birth rates, but in the south, where most economic development is taking place, birth rate is falling rapidly.
ex.t: 在印度北部，由于高出生率，人口正在激增，但在大多数经济发展正在进行的南部，出生率正在迅速下降。

ex.s: Never let anyone tell you， "You can't．" Dream big and climb high！
ex.t: 永远别让任何人告诉你“你做不到”。大胆梦想，勇攀高峰！
